resources.string: Notifications contain only opaque references, not session titles, messages, tool arguments, or audio. Opening one rechecks your current account and permissions. It never approves requests or sends commands automatically.
Firebase push notifications are not configured for this deployment. You can still turn on the background connection separately.
System notification permission has not been granted. The app will request it when you turn this on. You can also change it in system settings.
Verifying this device and registering for push notifications…
This device is registered. Delivery depends on the deployment provider and system connectivity.
Push notifications are off and will not initialize automatically.

Open a session you can access, then turn this on. A persistent notification with a Stop button appears while the app is in the background. Local drafts are cleared when the app goes into the background, except while the system file picker is open.
Only updates for the selected session are received. Write operations are blocked in the background. Signing out, invalid credentials, or tapping Stop in the notification disconnects the session.
System notification permission and an authorized session are required. Return to the session and try again.
The session was not opened. This reference has expired, belongs to another account, or no longer grants access.
Alerts are off on this phone, but revocation on the server has not been confirmed. Try again when online, or revoke this device in device management.
The operation did not complete. Check your account, deployment settings, and connection, then try again. No session content is shown.
